h: Making a trip of the Broadway
p: Broadway is Bexleyheath's main shopping street, pedestrianised for much of its length and anchored by the Broadway Shopping Centre and the clock tower, so you're right in the thick of things here.

It's worth knowing what's on the doorstep if you're coming from further out. Red House, the home William Morris built and now run by the National Trust, is tucked away in the residential streets nearby, and Danson Park, with its big lake and Georgian house, is only a short hop by bus or car. Admiral itself is strictly for over-18s and works best as a quick stop on a shopping trip rather than a day out on its own. Lots of places to eat along the Broadway, from chains to independent cafés and grill houses, so you won't go hungry.
